Test Scenario: Retrieve single user with valid existing ID (Positive)
Expected Response: JSON object with "data" containing user details (id: 2, email, first_name, last_name, avatar) and "support" metadata.

Test Scenario: Retrieve single user with non-existent ID (Negative)
Expected Response: Empty JSON object {} indicating user not found.

Test Scenario: Retrieve list of users with pagination (Positive)
Expected Response: JSON object containing pagination metadata (page: 1, per_page, total, total_pages) and "data" array of user objects.

Test Scenario: Create new user with valid name and job title (Positive)
Expected Response: JSON object returning submitted "name", "job", generated unique "id", and "createdAt" ISO 8601 timestamp.

Test Scenario: Create user with empty body payload (Edge Case)
Expected Response: JSON object returning generated "id" and "createdAt" timestamp (default fallback handling).

Test Scenario: Register user with valid email and password credentials (Positive)
Expected Response: JSON object returning registered user "id" and authorization "token" string.

Test Scenario: Register user with missing password parameter (Negative)
Register user with missing email parameter (Negative)
Expected Response: JSON error object: {"error": "Missing email or username"}.

Test Scenario: Update existing user full profile information (Positive)
Expected Response: JSON object returning updated "name", "job", and "updatedAt" ISO 8601 timestamp.

Test Scenario: Update existing user with partial attribute modification (Edge Case)
Expected Response: JSON object returning updated "job" property along with "updatedAt" timestamp.

Test Scenario: Delete existing user record by valid ID (Positive)
Expected Response: Empty response body with HTTP 204 No Content header.
